title: ARMS Part B Assembly
author: Laetitia Plaisance
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p69drh6

steps.title: Gather materials
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: 1 × PVC base plate (45 cm × 35 cm × 1.27 cm), 9 × PVC layer plates (22.5 cm × 22.5 cm × 0.63 cm), 4 × 7½‑ or 8‑inch stainless steel bolts (minimum 2 in thread length), 16 × ½‑inch long nylon spacers, 12 × ¼‑inch stainless steel washers, 4 × ¼‑inch stainless steel nuts, 4 × ¼‑inch stainless steel nylon‑insert locknuts, 2 × 7/16‑inch (11 mm) wrenches, silicon grease (Aqualube/Aquashield™).

steps.title: Insert bolts with washers
steps.instruction: Place a ¼‑inch stainless steel washer on each of the four bolts, run the four washer‑bolt assemblies through the four corners of a single PVC layer plate, then invert the plate so the bolt heads and washers are underneath and the bolt shanks protrude upward.

substeps.instruction: Run bolts with washers through plate corners

steps.title: Add nylon spacers and second plate
steps.instruction: Slide a ½‑inch nylon spacer onto each protruding bolt, then place a second PVC layer plate on top, creating an open layer that will become the top layer after inversion.

steps.title: Add cross spacers and third plate
steps.instruction: Slide a long PVC cross spacer onto two opposite‑corner bolts. On the remaining two bolts, slide one short PVC cross spacer each so they intersect the long spacer at right angles. Then place a third PVC layer plate on top, forming a closed layer.

substeps.instruction: Slide long cross spacer onto two opposite bolts
Slide short cross spacers onto the other two bolts (one each)

steps.title: Build remaining alternating layers
steps.instruction: Repeat the actions of Step 2 (washer‑bolt‑plate inversion) and Step 3 (nylon spacer + plate) to create an open layer, then repeat Step 4 to create a closed layer. Continue alternating until you have four open layers and four closed layers (total eight PVC plates), ensuring the layer directly above the base plate is a closed layer.

substeps.instruction: Repeat washer‑bolt‑plate inversion and add nylon spacer + plate (open layer)
Continue alternation until four open and four closed layers are assembled

steps.title: Grease threads and secure nuts
steps.instruction: After the fourth closed layer is complete, apply silicon grease (Aqualube/Aquashield™) to the threads of all bolts, place a ¼‑inch washer and a ¼‑inch stainless steel nut onto each bolt, and tighten securely.

substeps.instruction: Apply silicon grease to bolt threads

steps.title: Attach base plate and locknuts
steps.instruction: Place the 45 cm × 35 cm × 1.27 cm PVC base plate on the bolts with the counter‑sunk side down; re‑apply silicon grease to bolt tips if needed. Add a ¼‑inch washer and a ¼‑inch nylon‑insert locknut to each bolt, then tighten securely using two 7/16‑inch (11 mm) wrenches—one to hold the bolt and the other to turn the locknut.

substeps.instruction: Position base plate on bolts (counter‑sunk side down)
Coat bolt tips with silicon grease if needed
Add nylon‑insert locknut to each bolt

steps.title: Invert assembly and final check
steps.instruction: Invert the entire ARMS structure so the base plate rests on the bottom. Verify that the layer directly above the base plate is a closed layer, that there is no gap between the base plate and plate #1 (the plate in contact with the base plate), and confirm the assembly is complete.

substeps.instruction: Confirm closed layer is directly above base plate
Ensure no space between base plate and plate #1
